invoicePairs.title: Invoices on both sides
invoicePairs.intro: Some invoices PMO raised are also in your ERP. Count each sale once, as the ERP copy. The PMO copy stays on record, linked to it, and stops adding to revenue and receivables.

invoicePairs.undoBody: The PMO invoice goes back into revenue and receivables. The ERP invoice {{erp}} stays, so if both count, the sale shows twice until you pair them again.

erpCancelled.title: ERP invoice cancelled
erpCancelled.help: The cancelled ERP copy and the paired PMO copy are excluded from the project invoice total. If the sale still stands, undo the pair. If the sale was cancelled, leave it paired.

erpUnknown.title: ERP invoice status unknown
erpUnknown.help: The ERP invoice status could not be confirmed. Review the pair before deciding whether to undo it.

invoicePairs.undoBodyCancelled: ERP invoice {{erp}} is cancelled. Undo the pair to count {{number}} on its own again.

modules.intro: Each module switches a group of features on or off for everyone in your organisation. Turning a module off hides its screens and settings. Nothing is deleted, and turning it back on brings everything back.

claimOverCap.title: Claims over the claimable quantity
claimOverCap.loadError: Couldn't load the claim quantity setting
claimOverCap.helper: A claim line is measured against the quantity still claimable on its work order line: the surveyed quantity when there is one, otherwise the accepted (BAST) quantity, otherwise the ordered quantity, less what live claims already took. Warn only lets the claim through with a warning on the form. Refuse stops the claim until the quantity is lowered or the next acceptance is confirmed.
claimOverCap.adminOnly: Only an Admin can change this.
claimOverCap.turnOn: Refuse claims over the claimable quantity
claimOverCap.turnOff: Only warn on claims over the claimable quantity

usage.pricingNote: Pricing not yet configured — margin will appear here once a per-credit USD rate is set.

agentCost.notEnoughSub: Cache hit-rate trends appear once usage spans two or more months.

projectIntegrations.unreachable: Couldn't reach ClickUp. Check the connection, then retry.
projectIntegrations.unlinkBody: Synced tasks are retained; syncing stops. You can relink later with the same or different settings.

employeeLinkConfirm.noIdentity: the ERP record carries no name, employee number or work email, so there is nothing to confirm it against.
employeeLinkConfirm.noMatch: no PMO user is matched to it yet.

people.dupCode: That person code is already in use
people.dupCodeSub: Choose another code, or leave it blank to have one assigned.
people.dupProfile: That user is already linked to another person
people.dupProfileSub: Choose a different user, or clear the link.
people.name: Name
people.errorSub: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.
people.empty: No people yet. Add the first person to record their documents.
people.formerEmpty: No former staff. People you mark as left appear here.
people.managerHelp: The manager is warned first when this person's documents are about to expire, and records the renewal.
people.managerReadOnly: Only an Admin or the people team (HR) can change the direct manager.
people.leftBody: They move to Former staff and leave every crew roster from this day. Their documents, hours and history stay on record.

roleNames.title: Role names
roleNames.intro: Rename the built-in roles to match your organisation. Only the displayed name changes; what each role can do stays the same.
roleNames.name: Name

terminology.intro: Rename these terms to match how your organisation talks. The new wording replaces the default everywhere it is shown, in each language.

documentCategories.intro: Every document is filed under one category. Choose which roles can see the documents in each category; people in other roles will not see them or their files. Admin always sees every category.
documentCategories.m365Note: Files linked from Microsoft 365 keep Microsoft’s own permissions. These settings control only the register entry, preview and open link in PMO.
documentCategories.name: Category name
documentCategories.viewers: Who can see documents in this category
documentCategories.newHint: Choose the roles on purpose: a new category starts with Admin only, so nobody else sees its documents until you add them.
documentCategories.hiddenNone: No job role is hidden from it.
documentCategories.archiveBody: No new document can be filed in it. Documents already in it stay visible to the same roles.
documentCategories.denied: Document categories are managed by an Admin.

documentTypes.title: Document types
documentTypes.name: Name
documentTypes.medical: Medical document (status and date only, visible to Admin only)
documentTypes.rolesHelp: Tick the roles to warn before a document of this type expires. A person's direct manager is always warned too.
documentTypes.archiveBody: It can no longer be chosen for new documents. Documents already filed under it are kept.
documentTypes.dupName: A document type with that name already exists
documentTypes.errorSub: The request failed. Check your connection and try again.
documentTypes.empty: No document types yet. Add one so documents can be recorded for people and equipment.
documentTypes.adminOnly: Only an Admin can change this.
documentTypes.daysInvalid: Enter 1 to 5 whole numbers of days, from 1 to 365, separated by commas.
documentTypes.daysLabel: Warn this many days before expiry
documentTypes.medicalNotice: Expiry warnings go to the people team and direct manager. The worker is told after release is approved.

labourCost.title: Labour cost
labourCost.intro: Turn approved timesheet hours into cost in money on each work order, at a cost rate you set for a person or a role. This is cost only, not pay.
labourCost.adminOnly: Only an Admin or Finance can change labour cost settings.
labourCost.locked: This would change hours already priced on approved timesheets. Start the new rate after the last priced day.
labourCost.duplicate: A rate for this person, role or class already starts on that date.
labourCost.noRates: No rates yet. Hours with no rate stay as hours, with no money.
labourCost.archiveDescription: It stops applying. A rate that already priced approved hours cannot be archived: end it instead.
labourCost.subjectClass: A labour class (people with no login)
labourCost.subjectClassCell: People with no login in this class

assignments.title: Crew member classes
assignments.intro: People with no login are costed by their class: a class rate prices their approved attendance.
assignments.empty: No crew member has a labour class yet. Admin or Finance adds one here; until then their approved hours carry no rate.
assignments.personHelp: People in the register with no login.
assignments.noPeople: Everyone in the people register has a login. Add the crew member under People first.
assignments.archiveDescription: It stops applying. A class that already costs approved days cannot be archived: end it instead.

problem.amount: Enter an amount above 0 with at most 2 decimals.

performanceIndices.title: Cost and schedule performance
performanceIndices.description: Sets the limits the cost and schedule performance indices are read against on work orders.
performanceIndices.low: Lower limit (below this reads as a problem)
performanceIndices.high: Upper limit (above this reads as ahead)
performanceIndices.helper: The lower limit must be above 0 and below 1; the upper limit above 1. Defaults are 0.90 and 1.10.
performanceIndices.savedDetail: The panels follow the new settings.
performanceIndices.invalid: Lower limit must be between 0 and 1, and the upper limit above 1.
performanceIndices.adminOnly: Only an Admin can change this.

idleCost.adminOnly: Only an Admin or Finance can change this setting.
idleCost.scopeHelper: People: idle hours times the crew present each day. Equipment: standby cost of rented equipment on days with idle time. Neither is added to direct cost.
idleCost.scopeLabour: Idle hours at the average hourly cost
idleCost.scopePeopleEquipment: People present and rented equipment on standby

issueClosingReport.title: Issue closing-time report
issueClosingReport.helper: Choose how the closing-time report groups issues, and set up department groups.
issueClosingReport.groupsHelper: Map issue types to named departments for reporting.

items.dupName: An item with that name already exists
items.name: Item name
items.targetHelp: Optional. Counted from the day a person is added. Leave blank for no target.
items.errTarget: Use a whole number of days from 1 to 365, or leave it blank.
items.heading: Checklist items
items.emptySub: List what a person needs before going to site. An Admin adds each item once; every person then gets the same checklist.
items.archiveBody: It leaves every checklist and no longer counts toward being cleared. Dates already recorded are kept.
items.documentType: Takes its dates from this document
items.noDocumentType: None: record the date on the checklist
items.documentTypeHelp: Pick the document type, such as a licence. The expiry is then kept once, on the person’s document, and also appears on the expiring list.

people.heading: Who is cleared
people.emptySub: Add people under People first; then their checklist appears here.

off.title: The clearance checklist is not turned on
off.sub: An Admin can turn it on under Modules, in People and crews.

person.errDone: Enter the date it was done
person.errExpiry: The expiry date cannot be before the date done
person.noteHelp: Keep it short. Do not record medical detail here.
person.notFoundSub: They may have been archived, or you may not have access.
person.heading: Cleared-for-site checklist
person.emptySub: An Admin lists what a person needs under Clearance; the items then appear here.
person.removeBody: The item goes back to not done for this person.
person.noDocument: No {{type}} document yet. Add it on the person’s record.
